chapter.verse: Pasian aw, kote nong paai khin a, ka panmunte uh na sukham khin hi; kote tungah nangmah na heh khin hi; kote ka ngei uh hong bangsak kik in.
Nangmah in lei na liingsak khin a, lei na khaangkham sak khin hi; kip lo ahih ciangin a kitam mate mat kik in.
Nangmah in na mite haksatna na thuaksak khin hi; ka dawn dingun nangmah in ko hong hoisak leenggahzu nong piakhin hi.
Thalte panin kihem-in a kikaihkhop dingun nangmah hong zahtakte’ adingin dial khat na koih khin hi.
Nangma it mite a suahtak theih nadingin nangma khut taklam tawh gualzawhna pia in la, kote’ ngetna hong pia in!
Ama biakinn sungah Pasian in thu gen khin hi: “Gualzo-a lungdamna tawh Sekhem gam khenkhia-in Sukkot gamkuam ka sehkhia ding hi.
Gilead gam in keima’ aa hi; Manasseh gam in keima’ aa hi; Efraim gam in ka siklukhu hi; Judah gam in ka ciangkhut hi.
Moab gam in ka kisilna kuang hi; Edom gam tungah ka khedap ka lawn hi; Filistia gam tungah gualzawhna tawh ka awng hi,”
Kua in khuapi muanhuai-ah kei hong paipih ding hiam? Kua in Edom gamah kei hong paipih ding hiam?
Pasian aw, nangmah in kote hong don lo khin hi lo na hi hiam? Pasian aw, komau’ galkapte tawh na kuankhia kei hi.
Ka gal dona uh-ah huhna kote hong pia in, bang hang hiam cih leh mihing’ huhna a mawkna hi!
Pasian tawh khauh takin i hih ding hi; amah in i galte hong sikcipsak dingpa ahi hi.
